warning: TEST KEYS ONLY. Each private seed is SHA-256 of its ASCII seed_text, so it is public by construction. Never pin these keys. The issuer is a reserved example name.

test_keys.seed_text: outbid receipt spec v1 TEST VECTOR key, not a production key
outbid receipt spec v1 second TEST VECTOR key, not a production key

how_to_run: Each case is "defaults" with the case's "with" laid over it: with.keys, with.iss, with.now_seconds and with.max_age_seconds replace the default; with.expect is merged into defaults.expect key by key; with.expect_remove lists expectations to leave out. body_utf8 and request_body_utf8 are the UTF-8 bytes of the response body and request body. A case with "token" verifies that token against expect.body_utf8. A case with "stream_utf8" first splits the trailer off the stream, then verifies the receipt it carries against the bytes before the trailer. "expected" is the verdict: ok true, or ok false with the first reason in the order of the spec's verification steps.

cases.name: valid_non_stream
cases.what: The non-stream receipt, as the Outbid-Receipt header value (X-Outbid-Receipt is the alias until 2027-01-31).

cases.name: valid_sse
cases.what: The stream receipt, read from the last SSE comment of the whole stream.

cases.name: valid_second_pinned_key
cases.what: Two pinned keys; the second one signed.

cases.name: valid_at_age_limit
cases.what: Exactly max_age_seconds old.

cases.name: valid_uppercase_hex_expectations
cases.what: The buyer holds its settlement hash in uppercase hex and its asset address in checksum case; hex case carries nothing.

cases.name: reformatted_pretty
cases.what: Valid signature, payload pretty-printed.

cases.name: reformatted_reordered
cases.what: Valid signature, payload keys in another order.

cases.name: reformatted_duplicate_key
cases.what: Valid signature, a duplicate resolved_model key added in front.

cases.name: reformatted_number
cases.what: Valid signature, issued_at respelled as 1.795392e9.

cases.name: tampered_payload
cases.what: One payload character changed.

cases.name: tampered_signature
cases.what: One signature character changed.

cases.name: wrong_pinned_key
cases.what: The verifier pins only another key.

cases.name: signed_without_domain
cases.what: Signature made over the payload text alone.

cases.name: signed_under_other_domain
cases.what: Signature made under OUTBID:DELIVERY_RECEIPT_V2.

cases.name: version_v2
cases.what: The token says v2.

cases.name: signature_spare_bits
cases.what: Last signature character changed in its unused bits: decodes to the same 64 bytes, not the canonical text.

cases.name: signed_duplicate_key
cases.what: Issuer signs a payload with resolved_model twice (decoy first).

cases.name: signed_reordered_keys
cases.what: Issuer signs the keys in another order.

cases.name: signed_pretty_printed
cases.what: Issuer signs a pretty-printed payload.

cases.name: signed_number_respelled
cases.what: Issuer signs issued_at as 1.795392e9.

cases.name: signed_escaped_character
cases.what: Issuer signs resolved_model with its slash written as a JSON unicode escape.

cases.name: signed_extra_key
cases.what: Issuer signs an unknown field.

cases.name: signed_missing_key
cases.what: Issuer signs a payload without payee.

cases.name: signed_extra_key_in_request
cases.what: Issuer signs an unknown field inside request.

cases.name: signed_non_hex_body_sha256
cases.what: Issuer signs a 64-character body_sha256 that is not hex. Refused, not thrown.

cases.name: signed_uppercase_body_sha256
cases.what: Issuer signs body_sha256 in uppercase hex.

cases.name: signed_mixed_case_payer
cases.what: Issuer signs a payer that is not lowercase.

cases.name: signed_string_issued_at
cases.what: Issuer signs issued_at as a string.

cases.name: signed_symbol_asset
cases.what: Issuer signs asset as the symbol USDC.

cases.name: signed_prefixed_settlement_ref
cases.what: Issuer signs settlement_ref in the rev A form eip155:8453:tx:0x...

cases.name: signed_not_json
cases.what: Issuer signs text that is not JSON.

cases.name: signed_array
cases.what: Issuer signs a JSON array.

cases.name: model_substituted
cases.what: The receipt names another model than the one the buyer asked for.

cases.name: body_changed
cases.what: The body the buyer holds differs by one character.

cases.name: request_body_changed
cases.what: The request the buyer sent differs.

cases.name: other_path
cases.what: The buyer called another path.

cases.name: other_network
cases.what: The buyer paid on another network.

cases.name: other_payer
cases.what: The receipt is for another payer.

cases.name: other_payee
cases.what: The buyer paid another address.

cases.name: other_amount
cases.what: The buyer paid another amount.

cases.name: other_settlement
cases.what: The receipt names another settlement transaction.

cases.name: wrong_issuer
cases.what: The verifier pinned these keys for another issuer.

cases.name: kid_names_another_key
cases.what: Signed by key 1, payload kid names pinned key 2.

cases.name: expectation_missing
cases.what: The caller gives no model to compare with.

cases.name: too_old
cases.what: One second past max_age_seconds.

cases.name: issued_in_future
cases.what: issued_at more than 300 seconds ahead of the verifier clock.

cases.name: key_retired
cases.what: The pinned key was retired at issued_at.

cases.name: key_not_yet_valid
cases.what: issued_at is before the pinned key not_before.

cases.name: sse_body_changed
cases.what: One content character of the stream changed, same length.

cases.name: sse_digest_comment_only
cases.what: A stream as outbid sends it today: digest comment, no receipt.

cases.name: sse_named_event
cases.what: The receipt sent as a named event before [DONE] instead of the comment.

cases.name: sse_wrong_byte_count
cases.what: bytes= does not equal the number of bytes before the digest comment.

cases.name: sse_receipt_before_digest
cases.what: The two comments in the other order.

cases.name: sse_truncated
cases.what: The stream ends inside the receipt comment.
